messages:
Maria Gomez: Hey team — Emerald Systems case study: transcript + raw quotes from last week's interview are up in the drive: https://drive.redwood/emerald-case-2026. We want a micro-case (300–400 words), a pull quote for the landing page, and a quick webinar teaser. Need legal signoff on quotes by EOD Thu so we can schedule the promo.

Sasha Patel: Saw the doc, thanks. I pulled 3 candidate pull-quotes in the 'assets' section. My vote is Quote A for homepage, Quote B for email. Will mock hero image with logo lockup tomorrow. :art:

Kevin Liu: Quick heads up — the interview references a "proprietary throughput pipeline" and a revenue figure. Legal needs the revenue redacted or customer permission. Please mark the lines that contain financials and technical IP claims. I can approve language edits but need those flagged.

Maria Gomez: Good call. Sasha — can you mark the two paragraphs (lines 42–47) where revenue and "proprietary" appear? I'll ask the customer for permission but want edits ready if they decline.

Sasha Patel: Done — added [REDACT] tags and left an alternative wording suggestion: "optimized inference pipeline" instead of "proprietary throughput pipeline."

Marco Rivera: Creative question — do we have Emerald's logo vector and a short product screenshot? Need both for the case hero and the webinar slide. If not, can we get 2 PNGs (1200x628) and a high-res SVG?

Sasha Patel: Emerald provided a logo pack in the drive under /assets/logos. Screenshot is in /assets/screenshots/raw — might need cropping.

Jonah Park: For the webinar: propose we run a 30-min customer session + 10-min Redwood demo. Also want to add a clear inbound lead routing rule: tag registrants with campaign=emerald_case and route demo requests to AE queue 'EMERALD_DEMOS'. Can ops add a webhook?

Casey Nguyen: I can handle the routing rule. Suggested config: POST to /hooks/leads?campaign=emerald_case with payload: {"email":..., "interest": "demo"}. Then SFDC mapping -> Lead.Owner = EMERALD_DEMOS. Will follow up with the manifest.

Kevin Liu: Re: pull quote edits — here are tracked edits I propose (copied into doc). Key change: remove exact revenue number, change product claim from "100x" to "10x" unless they can substantiate. That avoids potential misrepresentation.

Maria Gomez: Noted. I'm pinging Emerald to confirm whether they can sign off on the revenue figure and the 100x statement. If they say no, we'll use Sasha's "optimized inference pipeline" + "order-of-magnitude improvement" language.

LaunchBot: Calendar invite created: "Emerald Case: Publish + Webinar Promo" Thu 03/26 10:00-10:30 PT. RSVP list includes: Maria, Sasha, Marco, Jonah, Casey, Kevin. Link: https://calendar.redwood/event/emerald-promo-03-26

Sasha Patel: Draft timeline in the doc — copied below:\n```\nDraft timeline:\n- Thu 03/26: legal signoff + creative final\n- Fri 03/27: landing + email assets live (A/B subject lines)\n- Tue 03/31: webinar registration opens\n- Tue 04/07: live webinar + follow-up demo outreach\n```

Marco Rivera: I'll aim to have the hero comps by Fri 03/27 EOD. If legal asks for changes, request 24 hours for design tweaks.

Jonah Park: For demand gen, recommend two streams: 1) short LinkedIn + X posts day of publish; 2) targeted email to existing list with subject options in doc. Also suggest boosting to lookalike audiences for the webinar.

Casey Nguyen: Noted. For inbound qualifiers: set tag "source=webinar" and add score +10 for demo requests. Also set nurture sequence for non-demo registrants (3-touch).

Kevin Liu: Final legal checklist for publication: confirm no revenue numbers without customer signoff, no non-public IP claims, and the testimonial quote has explicit consent. I'll add a signoff checkbox in the doc.

Maria Gomez: Emerald responded — they can approve the "order-of-magnitude improvement" language but not the revenue figure or the 100x claim. They signed the redline with the consent checkbox filled. Kevin, can you do a final pass?

Kevin Liu: I'll review now. If I don't flag anything in the next 2 hours, consider legal approved.

Sasha Patel: Thanks — I'll swap the quote on the homepage to Quote A (redacted) and prepare email variants.

Marco Rivera: Uploading final hero comps to /assets/final now.

Casey Nguyen: Routing config pushed to staging webhook. Sample payload sent to #eng-infra for validation.

Jonah Park: I'll draft social posts and the webinar landing copy once legal thumbs up is confirmed.

Maria Gomez: Great work team. After Kevin approves, Marco/ Sasha/Casey — please sync and I'll schedule the publish. Quick reminder: objective is 200 webinar signups, 30 demo requests.

Kevin Liu: Legal done — approved language attached in doc. :white_check_mark:

LaunchBot: Publish task queued: emerald-case-2026.kanban -> Ready for Launch.

Maria Gomez: Publishing now. Will post the landing URL in this thread when live.

Maria Gomez: LIVE: https://redwood.com/customers/emerald-systems-case — promo email scheduled for Fri 03/27 09:00 PT. Webinar registration link: https://redwood.com/webinars/emerald-systems-2026.

Sasha Patel: Sent first teaser to social drafts. Will queue final copy after monitoring initial traffic. :rocket:

Casey Nguyen: Incoming demo requests will appear in SFDC queue EMERALD_DEMOS; mapping validated.

Jonah Park: Promo looks good. Monitoring registrant spike — will post an update in the morning.

Marco Rivera: Nice — closing this thread and archiving assets. If anything pops, reopen the doc. :v:
